content: i18n key management best practices: set naming conventions early and keep stable (renaming later is very costly); hierarchical/namespaced keys per feature map cleanly to i18next namespaces; never embed variables in key names (welcome_{username} breaks) -- put placeholders inside the string; use placeholder interpolation not string concatenation (grammar order differs per language); don't split sentences across strings; avoid multiple placeholders that force unnatural reordering; keep common keys (ok, cancel) in a global namespace and reuse rather than duplicating; audit and remove orphaned keys automatically; separate game content data (hero names, item names, zone names) from UI strings -- content lives in DB/config with per-locale columns, UI strings live in translation files; for Chinese (ZH-CN target) article/vowel-consonant branching requires data-driven lookup tables not code exceptions.
